mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Ghost Poro</titleLeft><mainText>Your Ghost Poro has been scared away, and you must wait before calling a new one.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Ghost Poro</titleLeft><mainText>You are currently gaining bonus stats from the Ghost Poro Rune.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLongDescLocalizationKey:
When your wards expire, they leave behind a Ghost Poro, which grants vision for @MaxDuration@s. Nearby enemy champions scare the Ghost Poro away.

Gain an adaptive bonus of @AdaptiveForce.-1*0.6@ Attack Damage or @AdaptiveForce@ Ability Power for every Ghost Poro spawned and when your Ghost Poro spots an enemy champion up to @MaxStacks@ stacks.

After gaining @MaxStacks@ stacks, additionally gain @CompletionBonus@ adaptive force.
mShortDescLocalizationKey: When your wards expire, they leave behind a Ghost Poro. The Ghost Poro grants vision until discovered. Gain permanent AD or AP, <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_Adaptive'>adaptive</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> for each Ghost Poro and when your Ghost Poro spots an enemy champion, plus bonus upon completion.
